verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच। अहिंसा परमो धर्म इत्युक्तं बहुशस्त्वया । श्राद्धेषु च भवानाह पितॄनामिषकाङ्क्षिणः ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said Which amongst these is more efficacious to a person, namely abstention from injury, the observance of the Vedic, ritual, meditation, control over the senses, penances and obedient services rendered to the preceptors.

verses.sanskrit: मांसैर्बहुविधैः प्रोक्तस्त्वया श्राद्धविधिः पुरा । अहत्वा च कुतो मांसमेवमेतद्विरुध्यते ॥२॥
जातो नः संशयो धर्मे मांसस्य परिवर्जने । दोषो भक्षयतः कः स्यात्कश्चाभक्षयतो गुणः ॥३॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said You have told it many times that abstention from injury is the highest Religion. In Shraddhas, however, that are performed in honour of the departed Manes, persons for their own behoof, should make offerings of various kinds of meat. A doubt has, therefore, sprung in our mind about the duty of abstaining from meat. What are the sins that one commits by eating meat, and what are the merits that one acquires?

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा भक्षयतो वापि परेणोपहृतस्य वा । हन्याद्वा यः परस्यार्थे क्रीत्वा वा भक्षयेन्नरः ॥४॥
verses.english: You have said SO So while discoursing formerly upon the ordinances about Shraddhas. How can meat, however, be procured without killing a living creature? Your declarations, therefore, appear to me to be contradictory.

verses.sanskrit: एतदिच्छामि तत्त्वेन कथ्यमानं त्वयाऽनघ । निश्चयेन चिकीर्षामि धर्ममेतं सनातनम् ॥५॥
verses.english: What are the demerits of him who eats meat by himself slaying a living creature? What are the merits of him who eats the meat of animals, slain by others? What the merits or demerits of hini who kills a living creature for another? Or of him who eats meat buying it of others? I wish, O sinless one, that you should describe to me this subject in full. I wish to ascertain this eternal Religion with certainty.

verses.sanskrit: कथमायुरवाप्नोति कथं भवति सत्त्ववान् । कथमव्यङ्गतामेति लक्षण्यो जायते कथम् ॥६॥
verses.english: How does one acquire longevity? How does onc acquire strength? How does one acquire faultlessness of limbs? Indeed, how does one become gifted with excellent marks?

verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच। मांसस्याभक्षणाद्राजन्यो धर्मः कुरुनन्दन । तन्मे शृणु यथातत्त्वं यथाऽस्य विधिरुत्तमः ॥७॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Listen to me, O scion of Kuru's race, what the merit is of abstention from meat. Listen to me as I declare to you what the excellent ordinances, in sooth, are on this subject.

verses.sanskrit: रूपमव्यङ्गतामायुर्बुद्धिं सत्त्वं बलं स्मृतिम् । प्राप्तुकामैर्नरैर्हिंसा वर्जिता वै महात्मभिः ॥८॥
verses.english: Those great inen who desire beauty, faultessness of limbs, long life, understanding mental and physical strength, and memory should abstain from acts of injury.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणामत्र संवादो बहुशः कुरुनन्दन । बभूव तेषां तु मतं यत्तच्छृणु युधिष्ठिर ॥९॥
verses.english: Numberless discourses took place. between the Rishis on this subject, O scion of Kuru's race. Listen, O Yudhishthira, what their opinion was.

verses.sanskrit: यो यजेताश्वमेधेन मासि मासि यतव्रतः । वर्जयेन्मधुमांसं च सममेतद्युधिष्ठिर ॥१०॥
verses.english: The merit acquired by that person, O Yudhishthira, who, with the steadiness of a vow, worship the celestials every month in Horse sacrifices, is equal to him who discards honey and meat.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तर्षयो वालखिल्यास्तथैव च मरीचिपाः । अमांसभक्षणं राजन्प्रशंसन्ति मनीषिणः ॥११॥
verses.english: The highly wise seven celestial Rishis, the Valakhillyas, and those Rishi, who drink the rays of the sun, all speak highly of abstention from ineat.

verses.sanskrit: न भक्षयति यो मांसं न च हन्यान्न घातयेत् । तन्मित्रं सर्वभूतानां मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत् ॥१२॥
verses.english: The self-create Manu has said that man who does not eat meat, or who does not kill living creatures, or who does not cause them to be killed, is a friend of all creatures.

verses.sanskrit: अधृष्यः सर्वभूतानां विश्वास्यः सर्वजन्तुषु । साधूनां सम्मतो नित्यं भवेन्मांसं विवर्जयन् ॥१३॥
verses.english: Such a man is incapable of being oppressed by any creature. He enjoys the confidence of all living beings. He always enjoys, besides, the praise of the pious.

verses.sanskrit: स्वमांसं परमांसेन यो वर्धयितुमिच्छति । नारदः प्राह धर्मात्मा नियतं सोऽवसीदति ॥१४॥
verses.english: The virtuous Narada has said that that man who wishes to multiply his own flesh by eating the flesh of other creatures, meet with disaster.

verses.sanskrit: ददाति यजते चापि तपस्वी च भवत्यपि । मधुमांसनिवृत्त्येति प्राह चैवं बृहस्पतिः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Brihaspati has said that that man who abstains from honey and meat, gains the merit of gifts and sacrifices and penances.

verses.sanskrit: मासि मास्यश्वमेधेन यो यजेत शतं समाः । न खादति च यो मांसं सममेतन्मतं मम ॥१६॥
verses.english: In my view, these two persons are equal viz.hc who worships the celestials every month in a Horse-sacrifice for a century and he who abstains from honey and meat.

verses.sanskrit: सदा यजति सत्रेण सदा दानं प्रयच्छति । सदा तपस्वी भवति मधुमांसविवर्जनात् ॥१७॥
verses.english: On account of abstention from meat, one is considered as one who always worships the celestials in sacrifices, or as one who always makes gifts to others, or as one who always practises the severest austerities.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वेदा न तत्कुर्युः सर्वे यज्ञाश्च भारत । यो भक्षयित्वा मांसानि पश्चादपि निवर्तते ॥१८॥
verses.english: That inan who having eaten meal, gives it up afterwards, wins merit by such a deed that is so great that a study of all the Vedas or a performance, O Bharata, of all the sacrifices, cannot give its like.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्करं च रसज्ञाने मांसस्य परिवर्जनम् । चर्तुं व्रतमिदं श्रेष्ठं सर्वप्राण्यभयप्रदम् ॥१९॥
verses.english: It is very difficult to abstain from meat after one has known itstaste. Indeed, it is extremely difficult for such a person to observe the great vow abstention from meat, a vow that assures every creature by removing all fear.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु यो विद्वान् ददात्यभयदक्षिणाम् । दाता भवति लोके स प्राणानां नात्र संशयः ॥२०॥
verses.english: That learned person who gives to all living creatures the gift of complete assurance, is forsooth, regarded as the giver of lifc-breaths in this world.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वै परमं धर्मं प्रशंसन्ति मनीषिणः । प्राणा यथाऽऽत्मनोऽभीष्टा भूतानामपि वै तथा ॥२१॥
verses.english: This is the high Religion which wise men esteem very highly. The vital airs of other creatures are as dear to them as those of his own self.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मौपम्येन मन्तव्यं बुद्धिमद्भिः कृतात्मभिः । मृत्युतो भयमस्तीति विदुषां भूतिमिच्छताम् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Men gifted with intelligence and purified souls should always treat others as they theinselves wish to be treated. It is seen that even those men who are endued with learning and who seek to acquire the greatest good in the shape of Liberation, are not free from of the fear of death.

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनर्हन्यमानानां तरसा जीवितार्थिनाम् । अरोगाणामपापानां पापैर्मांसोपजीविभिः ॥२३॥
verses.english: What necessity there be said those innocent and healthy creatures gifted with love of life, when they are sought to be killed by sinful wretches living by slaughter?

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विद्धि महाराज मांसस्य परिवर्जनम् । धर्मस्यायतनं श्रेष्ठं स्वर्गस्य च सुखस्य च ॥२४॥
verses.english: Therefore, O king, know that the discarding of meat is the highest refuge of Religion, of the celestial region, and of happiness.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा परमो धर्मस्तथाऽहिंसा परं तपः । अहिंसा परमं सत्यं यतो धर्मः प्रवर्तते ॥२५॥
verses.english: Abstention from injury is the highest Religion. It is, again, the highest penance. It is also the highest truth from which all duty emanates.

verses.sanskrit: न हि मांसं तृणात् काष्ठादुपलाद्वापि जायते । हत्वा जन्तुं ततो मांसं तस्माद्दोषस्तु भक्षणे॥२६॥
verses.english: Flesh cannot be had from grass or wood or stone. Unless a living creature is killed it cannot be procured. Hence is the fault in eating flesh.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहास्वधामृतभुजो देवाः सत्यार्जवप्रियाः । क्रव्यादान् राक्षसान्विद्धि जिह्मानृतपरायणान् ॥२७॥
verses.english: The celestials, who live upon Svaha, Svadha, and nectar, are given to truth and sincerity. Those persons, however, who are for satisfying the sensation of taste, should be known as Rakshasas pervaded by the quality of Darkness.

verses.sanskrit: कान्तारेष्वथ घोरेषु दुर्गेषु गहनेषु च । रात्रावहनि सन्ध्यासु चत्वरेषु सभासु च ॥२८॥
verses.english: That man who abstains from meat, is never put in fear, O king, by any creature, wherever hic may be, viz., in terrible forest or inaccessible fastnesses, by day or by night, or at the two twilight's, in the open squares of towns or in conclaves of men, from upraised weapons or in places where there is great fright from wild animals or snakes.

verses.sanskrit: उद्यतेषु च शस्त्रेषु मृगव्यालहतेषु च । अमांसभक्षणे राजन्भयमन्यैर्न गच्छति ॥२९॥
शरण्यः सर्वभूतानां विश्वास्यः सर्वजन्तुषु । अनुद्वेगकरो लोके न चाप्युद्विजते सदा ॥३०॥
verses.english: All creatures seek his protection. He is trusted by all. He never causes any anxiety in others, and himself has never to become anxious,

verses.sanskrit: यदि चेत्खाद‌को न स्यान्न तदा घातको भवेत् । घातकः खादकार्थाय त‌द्घातयति वै नरः ॥३१॥
verses.english: If there were nobody who ate flesh there would then be nobody to slay living creatures. The man who slays living creatures kills them for the sake of the person who eats flesh.

verses.sanskrit: अभक्ष्यमेतदिति वै इति हिंसा निवर्तते । खाद‌कार्थमतो हिंसा मृगादीनां प्रवर्तते ॥३२॥
verses.english: If flesh were not considered as food, there would then be no destruction of living creatures. It is for the sake of the eater that the destruction of living creatures is carried on in the world.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्ग्रसति चैवायुर्हिंसकानां महाद्युते । तस्माद्विवर्जयेन्मांसं य इच्छेद्भूतिमात्मनः ॥३३॥
verses.english: Since, O you of great splendour, the period of life is shortened of persons who kills living creatures or cause them to be killed, it is clear that the person who seeks his own, behoof, I should give up meat altogether.

verses.sanskrit: त्रातारं नाधिगच्छन्ति रौद्राः प्राणिविहिंसकाः । उद्वेजनीया भूतानां यथा व्यालमृ‌गास्तथा ॥३४॥
verses.english: Those dreadful persons who are engaged in the destruction of living creatures never find protectors when they are in need. Such persons should always be molested and punished even as beasts of prey.

verses.sanskrit: लोभाद्वा बुद्धिमोहाद्वा बलवीर्यार्थमेव च । संसर्गादथ पापानामधर्मरुचिता नृणाम् ॥३५॥
verses.english: Through cupidity or stupefaction of sense, for the sake of strength and energy, or through association with the sinful, men show tendency for committing sin.

verses.sanskrit: स्वमांसं परमांसेन यो वर्धयितुमिच्छति । उद्विग्नवासो वसति यत्र यत्राभिजायते ॥३६॥
verses.english: That man who seeks to multiply his own flesh by (eating) the flesh of others has to live in this world in great anxiety and after death has to take birth in indifferent races and families.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं स्वस्त्ययनं महत् । मांसस्याभक्षणं प्राहुर्नियताः परमर्षयः ॥३७॥
verses.english: High Rishis given to the observance of vows and self control have said that abstention from meat is worthy of praise, productive of fame and Heaven and a great satisfaction itself.

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु खलु कौन्तेय श्रुतमासीत्पुरा मया । मार्कण्डेयस्य वदतो ये दोषा मांसभक्षणे ॥३८॥
verses.english: This I heard forinerly, O son of Kunti, from Markandeya when that Rishi discoursed on the sins of eating flesh.

verses.sanskrit: यो हि खादति मांसानि प्राणिनां जीवितैषिणाम् । हतानां वा मृतानां वा यथा हन्ता तथैव सः ॥३९॥
धनेन क्रयिको हन्ति खाद‌कश्चोपभोगतः । घातको वधबन्धाभ्यामित्येष त्रिविधो वधः ॥४०॥
verses.english: He who purchases flesh, kills living crcatures through his money. He who eats flesh, kills living creatures through such act of caling. He who binds or seizes and actually kilis living creatures, is the slaughterer. These are the three sorts of slaughter, each of these three acts being so.

verses.sanskrit: अखादन्ननुमोदंश्च भावदोषेण मानवः । योऽनुमोदति हन्यन्तं सोऽपि दोषेण लिप्यते ॥४१॥
verses.english: He who does not himself eat flesh but approves of an act of slaughter, becomes stained with the sin of slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: अधृष्यः सर्वभूतानामायुष्मान्निरुजः सदा । भवत्यभक्षयन् मांसं दयावान् प्राणिनामिह ॥४२॥
verses.english: By abstaining from meat and showing mercy to all creatures one becomes incapable of being molested by any creature, and acquires longevity perfect health and happiness.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यदानैर्गोदानैर्भूमिदानैश्च सर्वशः । मांसस्याभक्षणे धर्मो विशिष्ट इति नः श्रुतिः ॥४३॥
verses.english: The merit won by abstaining from meat, we have heard is superior to that of one who makes presents of gold, of kine, and of land.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रोक्षितं वृथामांसं विधिहीनं न भक्षयेत् । भक्षयन्निरयं याति नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥४४॥
verses.english: That man will find all his wishes fulfilled, Departing from this world he will ascend to the celestial region. There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षिताभ्युक्षितं मांसं तथा ब्राह्मणकाम्यया । अल्पदोषमिह ज्ञेयं विपरीते तु लिप्यते ॥४५॥
खाद‌कस्य कृते जन्तून् यो हन्यात् पुरुषाधमः । महादोषतरस्तत्र घातको न तु खादकः ॥४६॥
verses.english: If ong cats the meat that has been sanctified on account of its having been procured from animals dedicated in sacrifices and that have been killed for the purpose of feeding Brahmanas, one incurs a little fault. By behaving otherwise, one becomes stained with sin. That wretched man who kills living creatures for the sake of those who would eat them commits great sin. The eater's sin is not so great.

verses.sanskrit: इज्यायज्ञश्रुतिकृतैर्यो मार्गैरबुधोऽधमः । हन्याज्जन्तून् मांसगृध्नुः स वै नरकभाङ्नरः ॥४७॥
verses.english: That wretched man who following the path of religious rites and sacrifices laid down in the Vedas, would kill a living creature from desire of eating its flesh, would certainly go to Hell. One should never eat meat of animals not dedicated in sacrifices and that are, therefore, killed uselessly, and that has not been offered to the gods and departed Manes with the help of the ordinances. There is not the least doubt that a person by eating such meat goes to Hell.

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयित्वापि यो मांसं पश्चादपि निवर्तते । तस्यापि सुमहान् धर्मो यः पापाद्विनिवर्तते ॥४८॥
verses.english: That man who having eaten flesh abstains from it afterwards acquires great merit on account of such abstention from sin.

verses.sanskrit: आहर्ता चानुमन्ता च विशस्ता क्रयविक्रयी । संस्कर्ता चोपभोक्ता च खादकाः सर्वएव ते ॥४९॥
verses.english: He who arranges for obtaining flesh, he who approves of those arrangements, he who kills, he who, buys or sells, he who cooks, and he who eats, are all considered as caters of flesh.

verses.sanskrit: इदमन्यत्तु वक्ष्यामि प्रमाणं विधिनिर्मितम् । पुराणसृषिभिर्जुष्टं वेदेषु परिनिष्ठितम् ॥५०॥
verses.english: I shall now cite another authority, depending upon the saying of the ordainer himself, that is ancient, worshipped by the Rishis, and established in the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मः प्रजार्थिभिरुदाहृतः । यथोक्तं राजशार्दूल न तु तन्मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणाम् ॥५१॥
verses.english: It has been said that religion which has acts for its marks, has been ordained for householders O chief of kings, and not for those men who are desirous of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: हविर्यत्संस्कृतं मन्त्रैः प्रोक्षिताभ्युक्षितं शुचि । वेदोक्तेन प्रमाणेन पितॄणां प्रक्रियासु च ॥५२॥
अतोऽन्यथा वृथामांसमभक्ष्यं मनुरब्रवीत् । अस्वर्ग्यमयशस्यं च रक्षोवद्भरतर्षभ ॥५३॥
विधिहीनं नरः पूर्वं मांसं राजन्न भक्षयेत् । अप्रोक्षितं वृथा मांसं विधिहीनं न भक्षयेत् ॥५४॥
य इच्छेत्पुरुषोत्यन्तमात्मानं निरुपद्रवम् । स वर्जयेत मांसानि प्राणिनामिह सर्वशः ॥५५॥
verses.english: That man who wishes to avoid disaster should abstain from the meat of every living creature.

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयते हि पुरा कल्पे नृणां व्रीहिमयः पशुः । येनायजन्त यज्वानः पुण्यलोकपरायणाः ॥५६॥
verses.english: It is heard that in the former Aeon persons, desirous of acquiring regions of merit hereafter, celebrated sacrifices with seeds, regarding such animals as dedicated by them.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिः संशयं पृष्टो वसुश्चेदिपतिः पुरा । अभक्ष्यमपि मांसं यः प्राह भक्ष्यमिति प्रभो ॥५७॥
verses.english: Doubtful about the propriety of eating flesh, the Rishis asked Vasu the king of the Chedis, for removing their doubt. King Vasu, knowing that flesh should not be taken, answered that it was edible, O king.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशादनिं प्राप्तस्ततः स पृथिवीपतिः। एतदेव पुनश्चोक्त्वा विवेश धरणीतलम् ॥५८॥
verses.english: From that moment Vasu dropped down from the sky on the Earth. After this he once more repeated his opinion, with the result that he had to go down below the earth for it.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानां हितकामेन त्वगस्त्येन महात्मना । आरण्याः सर्वदैवत्याः प्रोक्षितास्तपसा मृगाः ॥५९॥
क्रिया ह्येवं न हीयन्ते पितृदैवतसंश्रिताः । प्रीयन्ते पितरश्चैव न्यायतो मांसतर्पिताः ॥६०॥
इदं तु शृणु राजेन्द्र कीर्त्यमानं मयाऽनघ । अभक्षणे सर्वसुखं मांसस्य मनुजाधिप ॥६१॥
verses.english: Listen to me, O king of kings, as I tell you this, O sinless one, There is absolute happiness ! in abstaining from meat, O king.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु वर्षशतं पूर्णं तपस्तप्येत्सुदारुणम् । यश्चैव वर्जयेन्मांसं सममेतन्मतं मम ॥६२॥
verses.english: He who practises severe austerities for a century, and he who abstains from ineat, are both equally meritorious. This is my opinion.

verses.sanskrit: कौमुदे तु विशेषेण शुक्लपक्षे नराधिप । वर्जयेन्मधुमांसानि धर्मो यत्र विधीयते ॥६३॥
verses.english: In the light half of the month of Kartika in especial, one should abstain from honey and mcat. It has been ordained, that there is great merit in it.

verses.sanskrit: चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्यो मांसं परिवर्जयेत् । चत्वारि भद्राण्याप्नोति कीर्तिमायुर्यशो बलम् ॥६४॥
verses.english: He who abstains from meat for the four months of the rainy season, acquires the blessed achievements, viz., longevity, fame and power.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा मासमेकं वै सर्वमांसान्यभक्षयन् । अतीत्य सर्वदुःखानि सुखं जीवन्निरामयः ॥६५॥
verses.english: He who abstains for the whole month of Kartika from meat of every kind, gets over all sorts of woe and lives in complete happiness.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयन्ति हि मांसानि मासशः पक्षशोऽपि वा । तेषां हिंसानिवृत्तानां ब्रह्मलोको विधीयते ॥६६॥
verses.english: They who abstain from flesh by either months or fortnights, have the region of Brahma ordained for them on account of their abstention from cruelty.

verses.sanskrit: मांसं तु कौमुदं पक्षं वर्जितं पार्थ राजभिः । सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्थैर्विदितार्थपरावरैः ॥६७॥
verses.english: Formerly many kings, O son of Pritha who had forined themselves the souls of all creatures and who has known the truths of all things viz., Soul and Not Soul, had abstained from flesh either for the whole of the month of Kartika or for the whole of the light fortnight in that month.

verses.sanskrit: नाभागेनाम्बरीषेण गयेन च महात्मना । आयुनाथानरण्येन दिलीपरघुपूरुभिः ॥६८॥
verses.english: They were Nabhaga, Ambarisha, the great Gaya, Ayu Anaranya, and Dilipa, Raghu, Pura, Kartavirya, Aniruddha, Nahusha, Yayati, Nriga, Vishvaksena, Shasabindu, Yunanashva, Shibi the son of Ushinara, Muchukunda, Mandhatri, and Harishchandra.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तवीर्यानिरुद्धाभ्यां नहुषेण ययातिना । नृगेण विष्वगश्वेन तथैव शशबिन्दुना ॥६९॥
युवनाश्वेन च तथा शिबिनौशीनरेण च । मुचुकुन्देन मान्धात्रा हरिश्चन्द्रेण वा विभो ॥७०॥
सत्यं वदत माऽसत्यं सत्यं धर्मः सनातनः । हरिश्चन्द्रश्चरति वै दिवि सत्येन चन्द्रवत् ॥७१॥
verses.english: Do you always speak the truth. Never speak an untruth. Truth is an cternal duty. It is by truth that Harishchandra roves through the sky like a second Moon.

verses.sanskrit: पठेद्वा य इदं राजञ्छृणुयाद्वाप्यभीक्ष्णशः । अमांसभक्षणविधिं पवित्रमृषिपूजितम् ॥७१॥
verses.english: Do you always speak the truth. Never speak an untruth. Truth is an cternal duty. It is by truth that Harishchandra roves through the sky like a second Moon.

verses.sanskrit: श्येनचित्रेण राजेन्द्र सोमकेन वृकेण च । रैवते रन्तिदेवेन वसुना सृञ्जयेन च ॥७२॥
verses.english: These other kings also viz.,. Shyenchitra, O monarch, and Somaka, Vrika Raivata, Rantideva, Vasu, Srinjaya, Dushmanta, Karushma, Rama, Alarka, Nala, Virupashva, Nimi, intelligent Janaka, Aila, Prithu, Virasena, Ikshvaku, Shambhu, Shveta, Sagara Aja, Dhundhu, Subahu, Haryashva, Kashypa and Bharata, O monarch, did not eat flesh for the month of Kartika and therefore attained to the celestial region and gifted with prosperity, blaze forth with effulgence in the region of Brahmana, worshipped by Gandharvas and surrounded by a thousand beautiful ladies.

verses.sanskrit: एतैश्चान्यैश्च राजेन्द्र कृपेण भरतेन च । दुष्यन्तेन करूषेण रामालर्कनरैस्तथा । विरूपाश्वेन निमिना जनकेन च धीमता ॥७३॥
ऐलेन पृथुना चैव वीरसेनेन चैव ह । इक्ष्वाकुणा शम्भुना च श्वेतेन सगरेण च ॥७४॥
अजेन धुन्धुना चैव तथैव च सुबाहुना । हर्यश्वेन च राजेन्द्र क्षुपेण भरतेन च ॥७५॥
एतैश्चान्यैश्च राजेन्द्र पुरा मांसं न भक्षितम् । शारदं कौमुदं मासं ततस्ते स्वर्गमाप्नुवन् ॥७६॥
ब्रह्मलोके च तिष्ठन्ति ज्वलमानाःश्रियान्विताः। उपास्यमाना गन्धर्वैः स्त्रीसहस्रसमन्विताः ॥७७॥
तदेतदुत्तमं धर्ममहिंसाधर्मलक्षणम् । ये चरन्ति महात्मानो नाकपृष्ठे वसन्ति ते ॥७८॥
verses.english: Those great men who practise this excellent Religion which is marked out by abstention from injury, succeed in living in the celestial region.

verses.sanskrit: मधुमांसं च ये नित्यं वर्जयन्तीह धार्मिकाः । जन्मप्रभृति मद्यं च सर्वे ते मुनयः स्मृताः ॥७९॥
verses.english: Those pious inen who from the time of birth abstain from honey and meat and wine are considered as ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: इमं धर्मममांसादं यश्चरेच्छ्रावयीत वा । अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो न जातु निरयं व्रजेत् ॥८०॥
verses.english: That man who practises this religion consisting of abstention from meat or who recites it for making others hear it, will never have to go to Hell even if he be a great wicked man.

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः सर्वकामैर्महीयते । विशिष्टतां ज्ञातिषु च लभते नात्र संशयः ॥८२॥
verses.english: He, O king, who always reads these ordinances about abstention from meat, that are sacred and worshipped by the Rishis or hears it read becomes purged off of every sin and acquire a great happiness on account of the fruition of every desire. Forsooth, he acquires an eminent position among kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: आपन्नश्चापदो मुच्येद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् । मुच्येत्तथाऽऽतुरो रोगाद्दुःखान्मुच्येत दुःखितः ॥८३॥
verses.english: When afflicted with calanity, he immediately gets over it. When obstructed with obstacles, he succeeds in freeing himself from them with the utmost case. When suffering from a disease, he becomes quickly cured, and afflicted with sorrow he becomes liberated from it with greatest ease.

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यग्योनिं न गच्छेत रूपवांश्च भवेन्नरः । ऋद्धिमान्वै कुरुश्रेष्ठ प्राप्नुयाच्च महद्यशः ॥८४॥
verses.english: Such a man has never to take birth in the intermediate order of animals or birds. Born in the order of men, he attains to great personal beauty. Gifted with great prosperity, O chief of Kuru's race, he acquires great fame as well.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं राजन्मांसस्य परिवर्जने । प्रवृत्तौ च निवृत्तौ च विधानमृषिनिर्मितम् ॥८५॥
verses.english: I have thus told you, O king, all that should be said about the subject of abstention from meat, together with the ordinances about both the religion of action and inaction as framed by the Rishis.
